g.title: '@TRAP (EXIT): echo "EXIT $depth"\, trap "echo NESTED_EXIT $depth" EXIT :: @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 2' (54,691 us, 1.25%)

'$'''cat <<-'''EVAL_HEREDOC'''
{
 for i in {1..2}, do
 ( recursive_bg 2 ) &
 done
} | tee >(cat >&2) >/dev/null &
EVAL_HEREDOC
' (2,450 us, 0.06%)

done
